extraction.notes: Table 3 (Q3 2022 column, first column) on seq 13 (printed page 10); the same table is repeated at seq 42 (printed 24) and was taken from seq 13. Starting line is Net income attributable to common stockholders (494,747), which reconciles to FFO of 343,897 and Core FFO of 349,964 (verified sums). Diluted share count 139,981,959 printed in full, divided by 1,000 to 139,981.959 thousand; reproduces FFO/share $2.46 and Core FFO/share $2.50. AVB reports no AFFO metric. Casualty and impairment loss on real estate and Advocacy contributions show '—' for Q3 2022 and are recorded as 0. Unconsolidated entity gains include unrealized property-tech gains per footnote (1); categorized as investment_gain_loss. Joint venture promote, SIP loan reserve, condominium items, and income tax expense were categorized as 'other' as no listed category fits. The Core FFO line is labeled 'Core FFO attributable to common stockholders'. Reported EPS of $3.53 is not part of the form.
